text:
elena: Quick heads-up 1 TellarCare (healthcare prospect) asked for a short, focused POC: validate sustained throughput and tail latency for our 7B family + embedding spike behavior. They want a concise runbook and cost sketch by EOD Monday.
ben: I can take the load plan + scripts. Can we confirm expected payloads?
elena: Theyll be sending clinical-note summarization prompts. Avg prompt ~180 tokens, avg completion ~200 tokens. Concurrency target: 200 concurrent users, sustained 60 RPS, peak bursts to 300 RPS for 30s every 4 minutes. Embeddings: short queries, ~6k qps bursts for 45s (search-heavy windows).
tara: Proposed matrix: hosted baseline (managed API, single-region), dedicated small pool (3 gpus), and degraded fallback (3B model) to emulate graceful degradation. Use Poisson arrival for sustained and scheduled microbursts.
ben: Test harness: k6 for RPS shaping + a simple python generator to rotate prompt templates. Will capture response times, token counts, and server-side trace IDs.
ryan: Ops note: For hostnames/IPs we need their egress allowlist before we start. Also security request: they want KMS integration + proof of SOC2 controls. For HSM-backed keys wed need Private deployment.
ops-bot: project created: tellarcare-poc-3891, env=d-edged, creds emailed to elena.
tara: Run steps draft:
- Prep: exchange IPs, API keys, and sample prompt set (they should provide ~1000 prompt variants)
- Provision: spin dedicated pool (3x A10-equivalent) and a hosted project for baseline
- Warm-up: 30m low-rate warm-up to populate cache/KV
- Sustained test: 2h @ 60 RPS (Poisson), capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util
- Burst cycles: every 4m run 30s @ 300 RPS, repeat 30 cycles
- Embedding soak: run separate job with 6k qps bursts, 45s each, 20 cycles
- Fallback test: simulate node loss, verify model fallback to 3B, measure degrade profile
- Post: 24h soak + metrics pull and runbook writeup
ben: k6 example (single test):
```bash
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 10m --out json=results.json script.js
```
script.js will call our /v1/generate endpoint with randomized prompt from the corpus.
ryan: Pricing sketch (very rough): Hosted: ~ $0.30 / 1k gen tokens -> for a week-long POC with expected 10M tokens/day ~ $2100/day. Dedicated: 3-node reserved pool ~ $7k/day (includes infra amortization + ops) but offers much lower tail latency and determinism. Private/HSM: extra onboarding fee + infra.
elena: Ben, please produce a one-line cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated) for procurement. Tara/ryan, can you confirm HSM constraints so I can reply to their security contact?
tara: HSM: only available on Private. For Dedicated we can use our managed KMS with customer key import (not HSM-backed). Will add that to the security note.
ben: I'll share the k6 script and prompt synthesizer by tonight. Also will include a smaller embedding k6 job.
ryan: Ops checklist Ill handle:
- Add TellarCare IPs to allowlist
- Provision temporary certs for svc endpoints
- Enable trace sampling and 72hr log retention for the project
- Expose per-request trace IDs in response headers for correlating client logs
ops-bot: dedicated-pool spin-up started: pool-id=dp-3891, eta=18m
elena: Can we schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 14:00 PT to finalize instance sizing and run dates? Sales needs results within 7 business days.
tara: Proposed run window: start Wed 08:00 UTC, active testing 48hrs, then 24hr soak + analysis deliverable by EOD next Monday. That fits 7-business-day ask if infra is quick.
ben: I'll prepare a short README for the prospect that lists the exact IPs, test dates, and data handling notes.
elena: Great. After we run, Brian from TellarCare asked for a one-page summary with p95 tail, sustained throughput, and recommended deployment. We'll produce that.
ben: attaching note: will include dashboard snapshots + raw results.
elena: OK team, thanks. I'll draft the customer-facing email with dates and required artifacts (IP allowlist, sample prompts, security contact) and post it here after the sync.
ryan: FYI - if we hit p95 < 150ms on Dedicated and Hosted is >300ms, recommend Dedicated for initial rollout.
elena: Copy. Sync tomorrow 14:00 PT.
